    Sequential neural network module function factory

    Source: R/sequential_module.R
    sequential_module.Rd

    Creates a factory function that returns a sequential neural network module with the specified architecture. Used for Riesz representer estimation.

    Usage

    sequential_module(layers = 1, hidden = 20, dropout = 0.1)

    Arguments

    layers

    [numeric(1)]
    Number of hidden layers.

    hidden

    [numeric(1)]
    Number of hidden units.

    dropout

    [numeric(1)]
    Dropout rate.

    Value

    A function that takes input dimension and returns a torch nn_module.
